zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 二维码识别与长截图控制
changes: 新增本机二维码识别，支持多个结果、复制内容和主动打开网页链接
Chrome 插件新增常驻侧栏与暂停、继续、停止控制，App 可通过独立面板控制同一次采集
修复滚动截图目标窗口识别和暂停期间继续采集的问题
更新应用、菜单栏和插件图标，调整设置界面
限制实况文本分析图像大小和远程 OCR 响应体大小，修复隐形水印记录保存
Chrome 插件需重新导出并加载；仅支持文档滚动，虚拟列表完整性不保证
应用与 DMG 已通过 Apple 公证，Sparkle 更新包带有签名

en.label: Latest
en.title: QR recognition and long capture controls
changes: New local QR code recognition supports multiple results, copying content, and explicitly opening web links.
The Chrome extension adds a persistent side panel with pause, resume, and stop controls; an App panel can control the same capture.
Fixed scrolling capture window selection and continued sampling while paused.
Updated App, menu bar, and extension icons and adjusted settings.
Bounded Live Text image sizes and remote OCR response sizes, and fixed invisible watermark record saving.
Export and reload the Chrome extension after updating; only document scrolling is supported and virtualized-list completeness is not guaranteed.
The App and DMG are Apple-notarized, and the Sparkle update package is signed.
